validation.notes: Capsid shell only (icosahedral head), does NOT include the T4 tail/tail-fibers/baseplate, so it under-represents the iconic 'lunar-lander' T4 silhouette kids typically picture. Good for 'virus capsid protein structure' teaching point; a commissioned full-virion model is recommended for the primary Virus hero (see report gap notes). Not render-inspected visually in this pass.
